file_types.unique_rule: unique = distinct sha256 content per file type across the whole disk (archive members at every nesting level + loose files); totals.unique_files counts each content once across all types
file_types.new_rule: new = content whose sha256 is not in the Disk-1 / Disk-2 / Z4 index; raw old/new counts every copy by content (final_counts.json), unique counts each content once
file_types.verify_rule: top-level files extracted per archive (not inside a nested archive) vs the drive report (7-Zip header listing of each archive)

by_extension.type: (other long extensions, fewer than 1,000 files each)

pdf_classes.rule: cad = CAD/plot producer or page >= A3; document = office/scanner producer or smaller page. Class from the extraction worker's head/tail read; PDFs it could not read were resolved from data-4's per-sha class, then the Disk-1/2 run's per-sha class, then a whole-file pdfinfo read (sources). old/new by content: new = sha256 not in Disk-1/2/Z4.

rows.type: All other file types (Disk-1/2 did not extract these)

comparison.disk12_note: Disk-1/Disk-2 were extracted for CAD types only (pdf dxf dwg dg dpm stp step ifc db1 sat nc1 ...); unique = distinct sha256; archives from the early run with only a weak hash are not in the sha256 counts
comparison.rule: unique = distinct sha256 per type; earlier disks = Disk-1+2 unique + what Z4 added; new in Z3 = content not in the Disk-1/Disk-2/Z4 index

sds2.rule: an SDS2 job = a folder holding main/jsetup (or mem/mem_idx); unique = distinct jsetup content; new = jsetup not stored by Disk-1/2/Z4; files = every file inside job folders

by_extension.type: (other long extensions, fewer than 1,000 files each)

conversions.grading: graded r1 - independent verification in progress

admission.rule: > 40 real kills / 30 min -> 1.3, > 80 -> 1.15, <= 20 -> step up by 0.2 to resv_factor_max (3.0)

fix_plan_top.fix: closed solid geometry in the source model

members detailed in the source job
closed shells in the source model
bolt records in the source job
closed solid geometry for the imported reference model (the job stores open meshes)
IFC writer: IfcShellBasedSurfaceModel of IfcClosedShell as CLOSED_SHELL / FACETED_BREP, close or heal open faceted shells (re-convert reused STEP)
exact solid repair / reconstruction in the IFC converter
the joist manufacturer's detail model / drawings
exact geometry for those parts (tessellation / boolean accuracy)

conversions.class_rule: class 1 = opens, 100% of source parts, all solids valid, no stand-ins, per-part volume within 5%; class 2 = opens with valid solids but partial / stand-ins / needs input / invalid or off-tolerance parts; class 3 = no STEP, unreadable, empty, corrupt or geometry-free source, member coverage < 50%, absurd bbox, blank render

pdf_classes.rule: cad = CAD/plot producer or page >= A3; document = office/scanner producer or smaller page; unknown = no readable metadata

rows.type: All other file types (Disk-1/2 did not extract these)

comparison.disk12_note: Disk-1/Disk-2 were extracted for CAD types only (pdf dxf dwg dg dpm stp step ifc db1 sat nc1 ...); unique = distinct sha256; archives from the early run with only a weak hash are not in the sha256 counts

source_identity.method: every object under s3://bim-proprietary-data/Disk-1/ and /Zentitude-data-4/ matched by path after the disk folder; byte identity proven per object by identical ETag, identical full-object CRC64NVME, or SHA-256 of the data-4 copy equal to the Disk-1 ChecksumSHA256
source_identity.note: Data-4 contains every Disk-1 archive byte-identical, plus 345 new archives. Disk-1 extraction kept only CAD types, so extracting data-4 fully still yielded content Disk-1 never stored; all content is deduplicated by sha256 against Disk-1/2.

conversions.rule: one job per distinct new content (sha256 not stored by Disk-1/2); disk12 duplicates were converted in the Disk-1/2 run

code_history: b 03:07Z: parse errors retried on ifcopenshell 0.8.4 (0.9.0 rejects Windows '-1.#IND' NaN tokens of Tekla 16 exports); disk gating + disk watchdog (large inputs expand 2-10x; 400 GB roots reached 88%); ENOSPC = transient; hand-off hot reload; started next to each box's code-a process via SSM

c 03:40Z: STEP writer name encoding fixed: names with two consecutive apostrophes (Revit feet-inch 8'') were written as '''' which OpenCASCADE 8.0.1 cannot lex (entities dropped -> segfault on read-back; affected outputs < 256 MB were never published, larger ones were published unverified); zero-area POLY_LOOPs dropped; read-back crashes -> readback_crash
d 03:49Z: runtime v3 (redo list _control/conv/ifc/redo_ids.json re-read every round; published a/b outputs containing '''' are re-converted automatically)

e 04:41Z (lead request after 27 ENOSPC convert_error on ip-10-0-101-74): at most 3 jobs >= 100 MB per host across all worker processes, disk reserved 40x input per job; the 27 were already re-opened by code d (ENOSPC = transient disk_full_on_worker, retried) and re-running since 04:34Z
ifc.jobs_note: 11,157 distinct new IFC contents (9,489 .ifc, 1,663 .ifczip, 5 .ifcxml; sha256 not stored by Disk-1/2). Genuine failures: no_geometry_grid_or_annotation_only = the model holds only grids/annotations (Tekla grid exports, reference 'out.ifc'); not_step21 = .ifcZIP files that contain an XML 'NewDataSet' (Tekla ExportedToRevit link data), not IFC; ifcxml_unsupported = ifcXML (plain or zipped): both ifcopenshell builds (0.9.0, 0.8.4) ship with the ifcXML reader disabled; empty_output = tiny ifcZIP models with no products; corrupt_coordinates = source geometry ~1.3e11 mm away even after tessellating the corrupt elements; readback_fail = 1 file (2d0f85a3bc80, Tekla reference .ifczip, 3,017 parts, sane bbox): STEP written in 11 s but the OpenCASCADE read-back did not finish within its 3 h limit, so it was not published (its sibling model read back ok after 2.6 h). The 2 download_error jobs (extraction gap) were requeued after the lead's repair and converted ok. The 49 code-a convert_error/kernel_hang results were disk-full (ENOSPC) and were re-run and converted ok; 56 early outputs with the old name encoding (or not scanned) were re-converted. Repairs applied where needed (input_fixes_ok): header normalization, legacy schema IFC2X2_FINAL->IFC2X3, truncated-tail repair, 0.8.4 kernel for strict-parse failures.
ifc.validated_note: validated = OpenCASCADE read-back (roots == parts, solids, bbox) for STEP < 256 MB; larger outputs are graded by entity markers + bbox and were scanned for the old-writer '''' defect (affected ones re-converted)

db1.jobs_note: 2,258 distinct new model DB1 (3,095 new DB1 minus 836 xslib.db1 component libraries and 1 zero-byte file). Genuine failures: no_member_layout (193: 8.85 x139, 8.07 x46, 7.98 x5, 9.08 x3) = no member table the decoder can verify (it never guesses geometry); diagnosed on 1ee70796 (8.85, 148 MB decompressed): only 489 records in the stride-73 member table every approved 8.x layout uses (a decodable 8.95 model of similar size has 18,136), point table at offset 12 instead of 17, no other table with a member signature - a record variant not reverse-engineered yet; in the Disk-1/2 run most 8.85 models had been converted by the original Windows pipeline, so this variant was rarely seen. suspect_attr_link (43) / suspect_orientation (1) = decoded, but held back by the attribute-link / member-axis guards (as on Disk-1/2); empty_model (14) = 0.1-0.8 MB blank/template models with no parts; unapproved_engine (9: Tekla 9.50 x6, 9.21 x3) = engine versions without a verified layout; deferred_layout (2) = full layout discovery exceeded the 2 h decode limit (65 MB 8.07, 292 MB 9.08); no_engine_banner (1) = not a Tekla model header; convert_error (1) = corrupt compressed stream in the source. The one download_error (extraction gap) was requeued after the lead's repair and converted ok.
db1.sample_validation: 5 samples on cad-zen2-files (engines 8.53/8.85/8.95/9.08, 1-72 MB): 4 ok (STEP 26-279 MB, OCC read-back roots==parts==written members, bbox sane, axis agreement 1.0); 71 MB 9.08 still decoding at release
code_history: b 03:43Z: same STEP writer fix as IFC c; runtime v2 (bridged next to the code-a processes via SSM)
d 04:41Z: runtime v4 (redo entries by failure reason)
db1.validated_note: validated = OpenCASCADE read-back for STEP < 256 MB; larger outputs graded by FACETED_BREP markers + bbox; 0 of 284 unverified code-a outputs had the '''' defect
